rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Hestia, revered Greek goddess maintaining the sacred hearth of Olympus.
ANATOMY: young female, one head two eyes two arms two legs; strong square jaw, resolute solemn expression, modest dark opaque full-length clothing and head-covering veil. Large clear bronze kettle beside her hand [hestia-c07,c19,c31].
POWER: she feeds and maintains sacrificial flames at Olympian hearth; a surging REAL fire burns wood and offerings inside stone hearth, physically lighting her figure [hestia-c06,c43,c45].
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close angle across fire, goddess fills frame; no giant stature.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one roaring hearth source, orange rim, deep walnut shadows, sparks and heat shimmer over hearth only.
SURFACE: woven veil, aged bronze kettle, charred wood, soot-black stone.
SETTING: royal sacred hearth of Olympus, plain stone without carvings [hestia-c43,c45].
MOOD: immense protective sacred authority, awe-inspiring resolute, never housewife, decorative portrait, cute or hostile.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no letters or pseudo-glyphs on stones/clothing/kettle, no text/logo/border/watermark, no extra anatomy, no modern film/game/comic design, no nudity/gore, no aura/neon/ribbons, fire stays at hearth not in her body.
MOMENT: She leans toward viewer and lowers a wood offering into the fire with one hand, other hand grips kettle handle, flames leap vertically between foreground and commanding veiled face. Dynamic low diagonal close-up.
candidate_choice_notes: All seven Sangar yes: veiled divine guardian dominates firelit foreground, purposeful wood-feeding action, kettle clear(c31), Olympian hearth flames(c06,c43,c45), opaque modest clothes(c19), standard anatomy/no text/no aura; direct imposing scrutiny over sacred fire. Preferred frontal action.

rejected_attempts.reason: Fails Sangar7: ordinary woman carrying kettle over fire; too little sacred imposing authority. Retry targeted towering sacrificial hearth fire and fiercely resolute expression.
